title: ½ Escudo / 50 Centésimos de Escudo

obverse.description:
Dark blue on pale orange on tan underprint.
Portrait of Bernardo O'Higgins in center based on the portrait by José Gil de Castro. Issuer name on top, face value in numeric fractions on all four corners, in letters at bottom, and in currency sign and numbers on sides of image. 
Red or black series and serial #s on sides (see comments section).
obverse.lettering:
BANCO CENTRAL DE CHILE
BERNARDO O'HIGGINS
MEDIO ESCUDO
CINCUENTA CENTESIMOS DE ESCUDO
CASA DE MONEDA DE CHILE
obverse.lettering_translation:
Central Bank of Chile
Bernardo O'Higgins
Half Escudo
Fifty Cents of Escudo
Chile Mint

reverse.description:
Blue on light-green underprint.
Engraving of the painting "Descubrimiento de Chile por Diego de Almagro" (Discovery of Chile by Diego de Almagro) by Pedro Subercaseaux. Issuer name on top, face value in numeric fractions on all four corners, in currency sign and numbers in oval at right, in letters at bottom and around oval.
reverse.lettering:
BANCO CENTRAL DE CHILE
★ CINCUENTA CENTESIMOS DE ESCUDO ★ CINCUENTA CENTESIMOS DE ESCUDO 
LLEGADA DE ALMAGRO A CHILE
MEDIO ESCUDO
reverse.lettering_translation:
Central Bank of Chile
Fifty Cents of Escudo Fifty Cents of Escudo
Arrival of Almagro to Chile
Half Escudo

comments:
The variations from P# 134 and P# 134A are mainly on color and position of series and serial #s.

 

 

P#134 - red serial # and series are place over serial #s; light-green reverse underprint.

 

 

 P#134A - black serial # and series are place below serial #s; beige reverse underprint.

Signatures varieties in P#134A:
Barrios Meza, Jaime (Bold)
Barrios Meza, Jaime (Slim)
(Images courtesy of Bank Note Museum)

watermark.description: Portrait (facing left) of Don Diego Portales (1793-1837)
